mapper.select: SELECT ap.id, ap.activity_id, ap.sku_id, ap.create_time FROM group_buy_market_better.activity_product ap JOIN group_buy_market_better.activity_config ac ON ap.activity_id = ac.activity_id WHERE ap.sku_id = #{skuId} AND ac.status = 1 AND ac.start_time <= NOW() AND ac.end_time >= NOW() LIMIT 1
